name: memory-persistence
description: Keeps a dated session-notes file across context compaction and between sessions, so work-in-progress state survives both. Fires on three events: SessionStart (surfaces the latest unfinished notes file), PreCompact (marks the notes file with a compaction timestamp before context is summarized), and SessionEnd (stamps the notes file's last-updated time). The listed event/command below is SessionStart; see scripts/ for the other two.
